title: MEE Phase Executor Input
description: Execute MEE phases with state tracking and resumable execution

phaseList.description: List of phase numbers to execute (e.g., ['43', '44', '45'])

mode.description: Execution mode: sequential (one at a time) or parallel (concurrent)

resumeFromStep.description: Resume from checkpoint (e.g., 'phase-45-step-12'). Omit to start fresh.

rollbackOnError.description: Automatically rollback to last checkpoint on error
